verdict.rationale: Automatic tax calculation is a fair question for a payments platform like EBANX, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents calculating or collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST on transactions. The cited material covers pay-ins, payouts, refunds, chargebacks, recurring payments and notifications, none of which involve tax determination.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
